## Changes

### Bug Fixes

- Fix long filenames overflowing the Override dialog by constraining trigger width and adding text truncation

### UI / UX Improvements

- Improve Catppuccin Mocha separator visibility with darker border color
- Improve filter button active/inactive states across catalog, configs, and override dialog
- Remove icons from catalog download buttons for proper text centering
- Improve dashboard card spacing, remove redundant icon, add Version label
- Align dashboard card content to bottom for consistent layout
- Add spacing between config separator and override badge in dashboard card
- Replace hardcoded dropdown highlights with theme-adaptive hover colors
- Introduce dedicated `--item-highlight` theme variable for consistent dropdown/select highlighting

### Refactoring

- Decouple dropdown highlight color from text color using dedicated theme variable per theme
